name: manual_f0d1ba
claim: When comparing a config with expected defaults, key the paths as tuples, not dotted strings, because model ids such as google/gemini-3.8-flash contain dots and slashes, and compare lists of id-keyed entries by id with only the expected fields, because OpenClaw normalizes entries on write and adds fields such as thinkingLevelMap; otherwise the drift check reports false drift or mangles the path.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-27 Phase 1 of the OpenClaw defaults: two test failures exposed a dotted-path lookup that split model ids, and a strict list comparison that flagged a field OpenClaw added itself; after the fix the redacted live config showed no drift.
